title: GS21 cash-flow exposure U-SHAPED IN LEVERAGE: three fixed-coupon types (0.15 / 0.40 / 0.70), production-level exposure gs_bv (0.3, 0, 0.3), price 2.5, no compensation
question: Does the distress-and-rationing story (cash-flow exposure U-shaped in leverage) give GS21 room and a fair gap at the bar, with leverage an observed characteristic?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-01, the user's story). High-leverage firms are in distress and low-leverage firms are (inferred to be) credit-rationed, so both are more exposed to the aggregate cash-flow shock than firms in the middle: cash-flow exposure is U-shaped in leverage, all else equal. GS21 is the model with debt. gvyzlf's chassis gives leverage a real cross-section (three types born with coupon 0.15 / 0.40 / 0.70 per unit capital, fixed for life, D/E about 0.25 / 1.0 / 3.25; the earlier leverage-curvature attempt gvyql/gvyqh had nothing to load on because endogenous leverage spans 0.002 to 0.006 across quintiles). The production-level exposure (gs_bzl 1) is gs_bv = (0.3, 0, 0.3): the linear part of the exposure in the coupon is near zero (cov(coupon, exposure) = 0.3 x (0.15 + 0.70 - 2 x 0.417) / 3), so a leverage sort does not hold it. With bv_comp 0 nothing is compensated: the exposed types are worth less per unit capital at y = 0, so book-to-market may reveal the exposed ends; gvylu30c is the compensated twin.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-01): the premium across the leverage characteristic is U-shaped; room 30% or more if neither value nor size reveals the ends linearly, and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below gvyzlf's 8% on three seeds (then book-to-market or size holds the U).

changes: gs_bv [0.1, 0.1, 0.1] on z~ -> [0.3, 0.0, 0.3] on the production level (gs_bzl 0 -> 1, gs_bzi 1 -> 0); bv_comp 0.0; three solves sol_gvylu30a..c; coupons, gs_fixcs 1, xi 0, y_mult 3.5 unchanged

method.gs_vy_exposure: production x exp(gs_bv (gs_bzl + gs_bzi z~) y)
method.gs_vy_sign_ladder: U-shaped production-level exposure across three fixed-coupon leverage types without compensation (bv_comp 0)
